# Omni Vue AI

> Omni Vue AI is the world's first full-spectrum brand intelligence platform. It measures, values, benchmarks, and amplifies brand exposure across social media, connected TV, linear TV, OTT, and news, in real time, in one platform, with the rigour the spend deserves.

Omni Vue AI is a SaaS brand intelligence platform headquartered in Halifax, Nova Scotia, Canada. It uses proprietary computer vision, natural language processing, and machine learning to detect logos, products, and mentions across text, image, audio, and video. The platform converts every detected appearance into a real-time exposure value metric that can be benchmarked against competitors, historical performance, and campaign spend.

The platform is purpose-built for three primary audiences: brands and advertisers measuring the ROI of paid media and sponsorships; agencies reporting campaign performance to clients; and rights holders (sports teams, leagues, event organisers) valuing and selling sponsorship inventory.

Founded by Nivin Xavier in 2024. Contact: hello@omnivueai.com · +1 902-540-0111.

## Key concepts and definitions

- **Full-spectrum brand intelligence**: Measurement of brand exposure across every modern channel, text, image, video on social, plus connected TV (CTV), linear TV, OTT platforms, and news, in one unified platform.
- **Exposure Value (EV)**: Omni Vue AI's proprietary metric quantifying every detected brand appearance based on duration, on-screen prominence, audience reached, channel context, and sentiment.
- **Share of Voice (SOV)**: A brand's visibility versus its competitive set, measured across every channel in scope.
- **Quality of Exposure (QoE)**: Prominence-weighted reach, a measure that accounts for how visible an appearance is, not just whether it occurred.
- **Capture / Measure / Benchmark / Amplify**: The four engines of the Omni Vue AI platform, corresponding to detection, valuation, ranking against competitors and history, and recommended action.

## How Omni Vue AI differs from other tools

Legacy sentiment platforms (Brandwatch, Talkwalker, Meltwater, Sprinklr, etc.) measure primarily text-based social posts, typically less than 15% of where a brand actually appears in 2026. Omni Vue AI was built channel-by-channel for omnichannel parity: text, image, and video on social, plus CTV, linear TV, OTT, and news.

Raw computer vision APIs (Google Vision, Amazon Rekognition, Azure Custom Vision) provide pixel-level detection but require the customer to build their own pipelines, brand libraries, valuation models, and dashboards. Omni Vue AI is the finished product, ready-to-use, brand-aware, channel-aware, at a fraction of the total cost of ownership.
